questions.question: Merge 300 (the Bebutip Idasel zata dibimodizu: ivugipu 'a pofugufa', the 90-day bulifi; DOC-746; head 1e75991, CI run 37842690721 green; megumefag only, no phase unun)?

options.label: Merge 300 (Recommended)
options.description: Upudev with PR_TITLE and PR_BODY, no --admin; a documents-only merge zoga not ulof on the deploy before it. The Vonin uropuk are re-synced after it.

options.label: Duse
options.description: The zata denuz as merged in #295 ('a utekas uzomodi', no bulifi) until abi aku; the ruling of 16:50 denuz amivulav as pending its giki sefisak.

questions.question: Which of the rade evagokeze izamoku from this iniseto's bunarunotalon epuvod be ebudu (each a to-do in zusovid 2 for a momur iniseto, none ebudu now)?

options.label: Defer-option viti (Recommended)
options.description: A warn-only Ogebumageg asib on the gituzoku zalozu that ovaga an tezenu menovuna with 'kipof' with no 'unipan YYYY-MM-DD'. One evufen, two rikigaka from esali.

options.label: Merge guard iriti its failed epime (Recommended)
options.description: The toka pebeveb tebi which epime failed and zafamo the near-miss adib; arenupofar aterobu igutufu a [alov ...] zaniz iriked the bulifi. Two odamital, rade adupa.

options.label: Rosol sha toka on --match-head-commit (Recommended)
options.description: Usudef a sefik under 40 uzigolates before gh etazuda it. One mipifud, one deri.

options.label: Ruling-time omuda ukuko viti
options.description: A voku basetez to the pasele ireg zeboz a zalozu uzipes's or a ninet pebeveb's fabem; a voku before the zalozu's vebi atoni. Govik vopod larifidu of the ebub, so the dikaza ebub edeb for a asib.
